Definition: of Hebrew origin (H8646); Thara (i.e. Terach), the father of Abraham:--Thara.
BiblicalUsage: Thara is Terah, the father of Abraham, named in the genealogy of Jesus. In Luke 3:34, which was the son of Thara.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Terah is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
